## Summary

Describe the behavior changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Regression test added or the reason it is unnecessary is documented
- [ ] `go test ./...` passes
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] `make generate` has been run and generated changes are committed
- [ ] No credentials, state, customer data, or generated binaries are included
- [ ] User-visible schema or behavior changes are documented
